comments.content: `:last-of-type` matches the last sibling **of the same element type**, not the last element carrying this class. In `add.vue` the direct children of `el-form` are the six `div.section-block` roots followed by `el-form-item` (also a `div`) and `div.form-actions`; the last `div` sibling is therefore `.form-actions`, so this selector matches nothing. Result: the final section (IndicatorSection) keeps its `border-bottom` and the 28px `margin-bottom`, producing a stray divider line above the remark field. Use a selector that is independent of sibling element types, e.g. `.section-block:not(:has(+ .section-block))`, or have the parent/section add an explicit last class.
comments.suggestion_code: .section-block:not(:has(+ .section-block)) { border-bottom: none; margin-bottom: 12px; }

comments.content: Deep selectors targeting Element Plus internals (`td`/`th`/`.el-table__row`) are dead rules under the current import mode. Both consumers load this file as `<style scoped src="./rank-common.css">` (RankTableView.vue:70, DeptRankTableView.vue:59), so the compiler appends a `[data-v-*]` attribute to the **last** compound selector of every rule: `.rank-matrix .el-table__body td` becomes `.rank-matrix .el-table__body td[data-v-*]`. `abort` 无条件 `DEL`,没有校验当前值仍是本次执行写入的 `PENDING` 占位。由于 `tryBegin` 的锁 TTL 只有 30s,一旦业务执行超过 30s,锁会过期:请求 B 重新 `tryBegin`(再次写入 PENDING)、甚至已 `finish` 写入真实结果 id;此时慢请求 A 失败走到 `abort`,会把 B 的锁/结果一并删除,后续同键请求拿不到结果而重复建客——正是幂等护栏要防的场景。建议改为「比较并删除」(Lua 脚本或先用执行者 token 作为 value,仅当值等于自己的 token 时才 DEL):
```
redis.execute(new DefaultRedisScript<>(
    "if redis.call('get', KEYS[1]) == ARGV[1] then return redis.call('del', KEYS[1]) else return 0 end", Long.class),
    java.util.Collections.singletonList(scopedKey), token);
```

1. `abort` unconditional DEL — no value check. Since the lock TTL is 30s and the business op may take longer, a slow owner A could DEL the PENDING lock acquired by a different request B (or even a delivered result written by B's `finish`). Real race. Suggest compare-and-delete via Lua (check value == PENDING before delete), or a token. Severity high/medium. comments.content: `is_null` 分支不可达：上面的守卫 `if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) return;` 会在进入 switch 之前直接返回。而 `is_null` 语义上本就不需要 rule_value（配置时通常为空/null），因此 `col IS NULL` 永远不会被生成，`operator=is_null` 的规则静默失效（WHERE 缺失 → 越权可见数据）。建议把 is_null 处理提到 value 守卫之前。

列名为 null 时 `escapeColumn` 返回 null，调用方随后做字符串拼接会生成字面量 `null = 'x'` / `null IN (...)` 子句（evaluateColumnFilter、evaluateOrgFilter 都受影响），SQL 会报错或产生无意义过滤，且没有任何告警。建议与文件内其它“坏配置即拒绝”的口径保持一致，对 null/空白列名直接抛异常（或由调用方显式跳过）。

这两个 catch 块是死代码，与注释声称的 fail-closed 行为不符：`parseFieldPermissions` / `parseActionPermissions` 全部基于 indexOf/substring/split/Boolean.parseBoolean，对任何输入都不会抛异常。因此 `{"hidden":` 这类残缺 JSON 只会被静默忽略（返回时 extractArray 因数组未闭合直接 return），不会抛 503，字段脱敏/操作限制会无声失效——正是注释想避免的场景。建议在解析函数中显式校验结构（键存在但数组缺失/未闭合、JSON 不以 { 开头等）并抛异常，或删除误导性的 catch 注释。

comments.content: 变量替换只遍历 `ctx.variables`，若白名单变量不在 ctx 中（例如 `evaluate(rules, null)` 时 `VariableContext.from(null)` 返回空 context，或后续新增白名单键但忘了注入），占位符会原样残留：`${user.userId}` 被拼进 SQL WHERE 子句/操作校验，导致语法错误或过滤条件被绕过。建议替换完成后检测残留 `${...}` 并抛异常。

field_visible 规则未按 target_entity 隔离：hidden/visible 是从所有实体的规则里合并成一个全局集合，而消费方 FieldFilterAdvice 对所有 JSON 响应统一套用，因此一条绑定到 `order` 的字段隐藏规则也会把 `customer` 响应里的同名字段隐藏（跨实体误伤）。这与本文件为 action_control 专门按 target_entity 分组的意图不一致，建议同样按实体聚合，或强制 field_visible 显式声明 target_entity。

对可空字符串做 switch 存在 NPE 风险：`rule.getOperator()`（以及 evaluate/evaluateForEntity 中的 `switch (rule.getRuleType())`）为 null 时（实体字段均可空，无 NOT NULL 约束）会直接抛 NullPointerException，导致整个请求 500；另外未知 operator 会被静默忽略，配置写错时无任何日志。建议先做 null 判断并记录未知操作符告警。
每次 `resolve` 调用都重新 `Pattern.compile`（规则数 × 请求数，典型热点路径），正则编译成本可观。建议提升为 static final Pattern 常量并复用（上面残留占位符校验也可复用同一常量）。

Callers such as `ScopeService.visibleDeptTree`/`SysUserService` pass `SecurityUtils.getCurrentUser()`, which may legitimately be null outside an authenticated request (e.g. scheduled/async paths). Suggest adding an explicit null guard returning an empty list (fail-closed).

comments.content: Trusted-proxy detection in ClientIpUtils fails for common deployments: the default trusted CIDRs exclude loopback (127.0.0.0/8, ::1) so a co-located nginx peer is not trusted, and ipToLong only understands dotted-quad IPv4 so any IPv6 peer (including ::ffff:x.x.x.x) returns -1 and is rejected. In both cases X-Real-IP is discarded and all requests are attributed to the proxy, collapsing per-IP login rate limiting/audit to one bucket. Include loopback in defaults and handle IPv6 (or at least unwrap IPv4-mapped addresses).

Finding 1: IPv6 / loopback. The default trusted CIDRs don't include 127.0.0.0/8 or ::1. If nginx runs on the same host (common for Spring Boot behind local nginx), remoteAddr = 127.0.0.1 → isTrustedProxy false → X-Real-IP ignored → all clients get "127.0.0.1" as rate-limit key, so login rate limiting becomes global (one attacker can lock out everyone / bypass per-IP limit... actually it makes the limit shared, so an attacker can exhaust others' quota). This is a genuine security-relevant limitation. Worth flagging as medium/high.

comments.content: `allowCredentials(true)` is combined with `setAllowedOriginPatterns(...)`, and the patterns come entirely from an external property (`cors.allowed-origins` / `CORS_ORIGINS`). comments.content:
The class name and Javadoc claim to provide the polymorphic whitelist protection (M5), but the whitelist actually lives entirely in the injected `ObjectMapper`. The constructor accepts any `ObjectMapper` without validation, so if it is ever instantiated with a mapper that has no default typing (or a permissive `LaissezFaireSubTypeValidator`), the caller gets `@class`-driven polymorphic deserialization without any protection (gadget risk) and no warning. Also, `mapper == null` is not rejected early, which produces a deferred NPE on the first serialize/deserialize call.

Suggestion: fail fast in the constructor (non-null check), and ideally verify/document that the mapper has default typing enabled with a `PolymorphicTypeValidator`.

`serialize(null)` returns an empty byte array while `deserialize(new byte[0])` returns null. This is consistent for a null round-trip (and matches the old serializer), but it also means a value that legitimately serializes to zero bytes is indistinguishable from "absent". Since callers (e.g. RedisTemplate operations) may store the empty array as a real key value rather than skipping the write, consider documenting this behavior at the method level or returning `null` for a null input so the contract is unambiguous.

Input size is unbounded: only `@NotBlank` is enforced, so an arbitrarily long username/password is accepted. This is forwarded to the authentication/password-hashing logic and can be abused for resource exhaustion (e.g. extremely long BCrypt input). Add reasonable upper bounds using `@Size`, and optionally a lower bound for the password.

comments.content: Lost-update race condition: the version check (read) and the write are separate, non-atomic steps and there is no `@Transactional`/conditional UPDATE. Two devices saving concurrently both read version=1, both pass the `serverV != clientV` check, and both write — the second write silently overwrites the first (version becomes 2 instead of 3), so the "optimistic lock" contract is not actually enforced. Use an atomic conditional update and verify the affected row count (e.g. `UPDATE biz_form_draft SET draft_data=?, version=version+1 WHERE id=? AND version=?`, retry/throw 409 when 0 rows), or enable MyBatis-Plus `@Version` optimistic locking with `OptimisticLockerInnerInterceptor`.

Wrap the operation in a transaction and handle the duplicate-key case by re-reading and retrying as an update (or raise a 409), or use an atomic `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE`.

comments.content: This whitelist based check causes silent data loss: an opaque storage key/URL that has no scheme, does not contain `/api/file/download/`, and has no known extension (e.g. `ossKey: 'incentive/2026/ab12cd'`, or a download URL ending in `/download?id=9`) returns `false`.
